_readme: 典籍目录页插图(docs/book-page-proposal.md §3)。每本书若干候选 prompt,gen-book-art.mjs 逐条调 Codex 出图进 scripts/.cache/book-art/,人眼挑一张(pick = 候选下标)后落 public/book-art/<组>/<slug>.png(只留 alpha 通道、800²,当 CSS 遮罩用)。prompt 守 §3.1:单色白描 / 减笔水墨、透明底、无字无印无框无人脸、主体占三分之一偏一侧、上方留白。
_style: Chinese baimiao (白描) ink line drawing with restrained light ink wash, SINGLE black ink only, on a FULLY TRANSPARENT background (alpha channel, nothing behind the strokes), no paper texture, no text, no Chinese characters, no seal, no border, no frame, no signature. Composition: the subject occupies about one third of the canvas and sits in the lower part, leaving the upper half mostly empty. Square 1024x1024.
